_doc: Where each chapter card's live copy sits (number + its rule + every title line), in fractions of the card
face (x right, y down), measured in the browser with the pose removed (MapTableHome, Rubik / Merriweather).
The card art keeps this zone blank card stock: pad = clearance around the letters (incl. the italic slant),
fade = width of the art's natural run-out into the paper beyond it.
